weather wasn't really on our side tonight, the snow was sticky, damp and didn't want to be groomed, and we visibly lost snow during the night, but we got it done! The Courses for the Hoppet have all been groomed and track set to the best of our abilities given the conditions. Some spots to look out for are AGL Corner at the bottom of Tank hill, it isn't as nice as I would have liked, but it was the best I could do. I don't think it will be an issue as it is slightly out of the way. The Aqueduct is very thin for about 10 meters, just after the Nordic Bowl (thanks to the Volunteers who shoveled some snow onto it) I was told that the Dam Wall is very thin and lost snow during the night. Other than the above, everything has decent cover on it. I was also able to groom the Aqueduct from Wombats to High Plains Road. As of 3am we have not yet had a freeze and there is fog lingering, but hopefully that clears and we get a freeze before the racing. Good luck to all the competitors from myself, Ben and Danny!
